### What to do next (run exactly these, in order)

```bash

python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```

### What each step will produce
1) **`aub_autopilot.py ... --select-best`**  
   Runs module-level candidates from `module_registry.yaml`, evaluates them, and (if any beat the champion by your configured criteria) selects the best.

2) **`system_autopilot.py ...`**  
   Runs system-level candidates defined in `system_candidates.yaml` (end-to-end style comparisons).

3) **`aub_next_fix.py ... --output ...next_fix.md`**  
   Generates a “what to fix next” report at:
   - `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`

### If you paste results, I can help decide/diagnose
After running, paste:
- the console summary for both autopilots (especially any “selected best” / “promoted” lines),
- and the contents (or key sections) of `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`.

If you want, also tell me what “better” means in your setup (lower is better vs higher is better), since the handoff shows means/mins but not the optimization direction.
